_comment: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqchat-vectors.mjs (src/pqchat.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. Sources: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-ua7-pq-e2e-sessions.md (§4, §6, §7, §10), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-pqchat-public-topics.md (§2), plan block "Group 3c" (3C-D3, 3C-D5, 3C-D9). UNAUDITED. Public topics (topics spec P35, P36). Domain, purpose and signing as records.json (the same DS_C, PURPOSE_PQCHAT, kind 0x0131, the signers of records.json). Ids: topicId = keccak256(abi.encode(tag topic, owner, uint64 nonce)); entryId = keccak256(abi.encode(tag entry, topicId, author, uint64 nonce)). Scopes (3C-D5): topic keccak256(abi.encode(tag scope/topic, owner)); entries and edits keccak256(abi.encode(tag scope/entry, topicId, author)), an edit under its original's topicId; update, writer and vote replace a value by seq and have no scope. Each row: uaSig a real ML-DSA-65 signature over uaMessage.digest, sigHash = keccak256(abi.encode(UASig)), blob = abi.encode(record as its ABI tuple, sigHash) (P39, 3C-D3); int8 value as its sign-extended word (-1 = 0xff…ff). post: a post (parentId 0) with ref all zero; reply: every field non-zero, ref = the post as an entry of another instance on another chain, contentHash = typed(post), refHash = hashStruct(EntryRef); edit: version 2 of the reply; vote: -1 on the post.

PqTopic.type: PqTopic(bytes32 owner,uint64 nonce,bytes32 homeChain,address homeChatContract,string name,bytes about,bool openReplies)

PqTopicUpdate.type: PqTopicUpdate(bytes32 topicId,uint64 seq,string name,bytes about,bool openReplies)

PqTopicEntry.type: PqTopicEntry(bytes32 topicId,bytes32 author,uint64 nonce,bytes32 parentId,EntryRef ref,string mediaType,bytes body)EntryRef(bytes32 chainUid,address pqchat,bytes32 entryId,bytes32 contentHash)

PqTopicEdit.type: PqTopicEdit(bytes32 entryId,bytes32 author,uint64 nonce,uint32 version,string mediaType,bytes body)
